reason: In scope (passive, 8 ohm nominal per ATC, 6in sealed, 381 mm, sold new in US; USA Tube Audio $2,699/pair). But the only Tier B measurement found (Stereophile, John Atkinson, 2009-12-14) is of the superseded first-generation SCM11; the 2015 v2 (new tweeter, new cabinet and crossover, 2.2 kHz vs ~2.8 kHz measured) has no independent measurement found. Pages not created.
v1_stereophile_values: v1 only: sensitivity ~82 dB(B)/2.83V/m est. vs 85 claimed; impedance >8 ohm most of band, 6 ohm dip 100-300 Hz, 4.8 ohm mid-treble, 5.5 ohm/-42 deg at 3.3 kHz; woofer nearfield -6 dB at 53 Hz (sealed); two sidewall resonances 500-600 Hz; vertical suckout above tweeter axis at crossover; 24 dB/oct tweeter, 12 dB/oct woofer acoustic slopes
mfr_specs: 6in CLD woofer, 1in soft dome, sealed, 8 ohm nominal, 85 dB @1W/1m claimed (~84.0 dB 2.83V if 8 ohm... treat as 85 claimed), FR 56 Hz-22 kHz (-6 dB), xo 2.2 kHz, 381x232x236 mm, 10.9 kg each
takeaways: Stereophile measured v1 only; v2 (2015) redesigned
What Hi-Fi? 2015 awards (v2): clean neutral, transparent, bass not deep
StereoNET (v2, GBP 1,450): smooth, controlled, benefits from sub
